snippet.title: Fell & Sell - Venturing Shopkeeper Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4627110/Fell__Sell

Slay. Loot. Sell. Survive! Dive into a first-person blend of hack'n'slash roguelike and shop management. Plunder deadly dungeons for loot, escape with your life, craft, and stock your shelves. Then risk it all once more for profit!

#shopkeeper #indiegame #rpg #fantasy
